title: Be specific in your Seedance 2.5 prompts and describe exactly what you want to…
content:
Be specific in your Seedance 2.5 prompts and describe exactly what you want to improve prompt adherence.  
Use precise terminology in Seedance 2.5 prompts, as wording choices significantly affect results.  
Use a brainstorming workflow of Midjourney first (to develop concepts/visuals) and then Seedance 2.5 for video generation.
tips:
Be specific in your Seedance 2.5 prompts and describe exactly what you want to improve prompt adherence.  
Use precise terminology in Seedance 2.5 prompts, as wording choices significantly affect results.  
Use a brainstorming workflow of Midjourney first (to develop concepts/visuals) and then Seedance 2.5 for video generation.

es.content:
Sé específico en tus prompts de Seedance 2.5 y describe exactamente qué quieres para mejorar la adherencia al prompt.  
Usa terminología precisa en los prompts de Seedance 2.5, ya que las elecciones de redacción afectan significativamente los resultados.  
Utiliza primero un flujo de trabajo de brainstorming con Midjourney (para desarrollar conceptos/visuales) y luego Seedance 2.5 para la generación de video.

fr.content:
Soyez précis dans vos prompts Seedance 2.5 et décrivez exactement ce que vous souhaitez améliorer pour renforcer le respect du prompt.  
Utilisez une terminologie précise dans vos prompts Seedance 2.5, car le choix des mots influence fortement les résultats.  
Adoptez un workflow de brainstorming avec Midjourney d’abord (pour développer les concepts/visuels), puis Seedance 2.5 pour la génération vidéo.

ja.content:
Seedance 2.5 の prompt では具体的に記述し、prompt adherence を高めるために何を改善したいのかを正確に伝えてください。  
Seedance 2.5 の prompt では、言葉の選び方が結果に大きく影響するため、正確な用語を使ってください。  
まず Midjourney でブレインストーミングのワークフローを行い（コンセプトやビジュアルを発展させ）、その後に Seedance 2.5 で動画生成を行ってください。

ko.content:
Seedance 2.5 prompt에서는 구체적으로 작성하고, prompt adherence를 개선하고 싶은 부분을 정확히 설명하세요.  
Seedance 2.5 prompt에서는 정확한 용어를 사용하세요. 표현의 선택이 결과에 큰 영향을 미칩니다.  
먼저 Midjourney로 브레인스토밍 워크플로를 사용해 개념/비주얼을 발전시킨 다음, Seedance 2.5로 비디오를 생성하세요.

pt.content:
Seja específico em seus prompts do Seedance 2.5 e descreva exatamente o que você quer para melhorar a aderência ao prompt.  
Use terminologia precisa nos prompts do Seedance 2.5, pois as escolhas de palavras afetam significativamente os resultados.  
Use um fluxo de trabalho de brainstorming com o Midjourney primeiro (para desenvolver conceitos/visuais) e depois o Seedance 2.5 para a geração de vídeo.

zh.content:
在 Seedance 2.5 的 prompt 中要尽量具体，准确描述你想改进的内容，以提升 prompt adherence。  
在 Seedance 2.5 的 prompt 中使用精确术语，因为措辞选择会显著影响结果。  
先使用 Midjourney 的头脑风暴工作流（用于构思概念/视觉效果），再使用 Seedance 2.5 进行视频生成。
